paragraphs: Rav Muna and Rav Ḥisda, Shemuel's student: I did not find it, and it requires examination, since R. Muna was early. In R. Yehudah's name, Shabbat 108b. R. Yitzḥak bar Gufeta before R. Mana. R. Yosef said the law follows R. Muna, etc. R. Yirmeyah bar Abba said: Rav said the law follows R. Muna; Shemuel said the law does not follow R. Muna, Megillah 18b. Shemuel said the law follows R. Muna, Keitzad Mevarekhin 42a. [The source's varying statements are retained.]
